steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-noon-tint
steps.eval: (()=>{const m=document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]').getAttribute('content'); window.__noonTint=m; if(m==='#ecdfce'||m==='#251f1b') throw new Error('status bar still static clay at noon: '+m); return m})()

steps.name: assert-sunset-tint
steps.eval: (()=>{const m=document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]').getAttribute('content'); window.__sunsetTint=m; if(m===window.__noonTint) throw new Error('sunset tint did not change from noon: '+m); return m})()

steps.name: assert-night-tint
steps.eval: (()=>{const m=document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]').getAttribute('content'); window.__nightTint=m; if(m===window.__sunsetTint) throw new Error('night tint did not change from sunset: '+m); return 'noon='+window.__noonTint+' sunset='+window.__sunsetTint+' night='+m})()
